item.title: Ask HN: What are your unfinished projects?
item.summary: For me, it a chess clock. I’ve got all the parts (esp32, oled screens, usb c charging electronics), the software is written, the case is 3d printed. All of this piled in a box on my desk mocking me. What about you? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49300450 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
